short_description: Curated notes, question banks, offline PDF viewer, quizzes & internship prep.
full_description:
MyVault is the premier all-in-one digital academic companion and career accelerator built specifically for Engineering & Technology students.

📚 STRICT SEMESTER & BRANCH ISOLATION
Access verified lecture notes, question banks, previous years' university exam papers, lab manuals, and syllabus copies filtered strictly by your branch (CSE, ECE, AI/ML, EEE, MECH, CIVIL) and semester (Sem 1 to 8). Zero noise, zero cross-contamination.

✏️ IN-APP PDF VIEWER WITH LIVE ANNOTATIONS
Read academic materials with high-speed rendering, freehand pen tool, highlighter, bookmarking, and local encrypted offline caching for study on the go.

🏆 REAL-TIME QUIZ & LEADERBOARD ARENA
Test your knowledge with timed competitive quizzes tailored for GATE, coding assessments, placement aptitude, and core subject exams with live rankings.

🔐 SECURE FIREBASE STUDENT AUTHENTICATION
Sign in with 1-tap Google Sign-In or your student college credentials. Manage your Digital Student ID Badge with end-to-end data encryption.

💼 INTERNSHIPS & PLACEMENT BOOTCAMP
Explore verified engineering internships, technical mock interview simulations, and verified certificate generation.

⚡ HIGH AVAILABILITY & CLOUD RESILIENCE
Powered by AWS S3 permanent multi-region storage and multi-node load balancing with automatic circuit breaker failover.
